questions.name: Field Completeness
questions.description: Proportion of mandatory schema fields populated
questions.evidence: id: https://doi.org/10.13026/37yb-1t42; title: 'Bridge2AI-Voice - An ethically-sourced, diverse voice dataset linked to health information'; description: ~1400 chars; keywords: ~50 entries; license_and_use_terms: detailed named license block with description
questions.quality_note: All 5 mandatory fields present (100%) with substantive content in each

questions.name: Entry Length Adequacy
questions.description: Whether narrative fields have meaningful content length
questions.evidence: description spans lines 10-27 (~1400 chars); motivation is captured across four detailed 'purposes' entries (voice:purpose:1-4), each a multi-sentence narrative
questions.quality_note: Narrative fields far exceed 200 chars with rich contextual detail

questions.name: Keyword Diversity
questions.description: Number of unique keywords describing topic coverage
questions.evidence: ~50 unique keywords including 'voice biomarker', 'acoustic biomarker', 'Parkinson's disease', 'Alzheimer's disease', 'MFCC', 'OpenSMILE', 'BIDS', 'FAIR principles', 'CARE principles', 'PhysioNet', 'b2aiprep'
questions.quality_note: Far exceeds the 8-keyword threshold with strong topical, methodological, and clinical coverage

questions.name: File Enumeration and Type Variety
questions.description: Number of files and file type diversity
questions.evidence: distribution_formats lists Parquet (spectrograms/derived features), TSV and JSON (phenotype/static features, data dictionaries), and WAV (raw audio, controlled access) — 4 distinct file types
questions.quality_note: Four file types documented, indicating multi-modal, multi-format distribution

questions.name: Data File Size Availability
questions.description: Presence of file size or dimensional metadata
questions.evidence: Spectrograms '513xN dimensions'; MFCC 'dimension 60xN'; '~61,937 voice-derived recordings from 833 adult participants'; counts: 833; v1.0 '12,523 recordings'
questions.quality_note: Explicit dimensional (513xN, 60xN) and count-based (participants, recordings) metadata present

questions.name: Dataset Identification Metadata
questions.description: Presence of unique identifiers such as DOI, RRID, or persistent URLs
questions.evidence: doi: 10.13026/37yb-1t42; id: https://doi.org/10.13026/37yb-1t42; page: https://docs.b2ai-voice.org; version-specific DOIs referenced in version_access
questions.quality_note: Persistent DOI plus version-specific DOIs and a project landing page

questions.name: Funding and Acknowledgements Completeness
questions.description: Presence of funding sources, grants, or institutional sponsors
questions.evidence: funders: 'NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI Program. Grant number: 3OT2OD032720-01S3. Opportunity Number: OTA-21-008... Total funding in 2025: $4,660,942'; second funder 'NIBIB... NIH grant number R01EB030362' supporting PhysioNet
questions.quality_note: Multiple funders with agency, grant numbers, award amounts, dates, and administering institute

questions.name: Ethical and Privacy Declarations
questions.description: Presence of deidentification methods, IRB approvals, or ethical sourcing notes
questions.score_label: IRB approval + deidentification + ethical sourcing details
questions.evidence: irb_approval: 'University of South Florida Single IRB approval with subsite IRB approvals'; is_deidentified: 'HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification applied...'; Certificate of Confidentiality; consortium bioethicists (Belisle-Pipon, Ravitsky); 45 CFR 46 compliance
questions.quality_note: Comprehensive: IRB approval, HIPAA Safe Harbor method, Certificate of Confidentiality, and dedicated ethics module

questions.name: Access Requirements Documentation
questions.description: Whether access policy and license are clearly defined
questions.score_label: License + Data Use Agreement + platform access description
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms describes 'Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access License' via PhysioNet requiring signed DUA; raw audio via controlled access through DACO requiring DARF, DUA, and institutional DTUA (voice:subset:2)
questions.quality_note: Tiered access (registered vs. controlled) with named agreements and platform fully described

questions.name: Interoperability and Standardization
questions.description: Presence of standard formats, ontologies, or schema conformance
questions.evidence: 'BIDS v1.9.0 compliant format' (multiple locations); Parquet and TSV/JSON formats; 'Per Bridge2AI protocols and ICD-10 codes'; JSON data dictionaries per file
questions.quality_note: Standard formats (Parquet, TSV, BIDS) plus explicit schema/coding-standard conformance (BIDS v1.9.0, ICD-10)

questions.name: Tool and Software Transparency
questions.description: Mentions of preprocessing libraries or tools used in data preparation
questions.score_label: Comprehensive list with versions or URLs
questions.evidence: b2aiprep (https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep, Apache-2.0), SenseLab (https://github.com/sensein/senselab), OpenSMILE eGeMaps, Praat, Parselmouth, torchaudio, OpenAI Whisper; preprocessing params (16 kHz resampling, 25ms window, 512-point FFT)
questions.quality_note: Extensive tool list with repository URLs, licenses, and concrete processing parameters

questions.name: Collection Protocol Clarity
questions.description: Description completeness of participant recruitment and data acquisition
questions.score_label: Full recruitment and procedural details included
questions.evidence: sampling_strategies (purposive sampling from high-volume specialty clinics, inclusion/exclusion per protocol Table 1); collection_mechanisms (Bridge2AI-Voice App on iPad with Avid AE-36 mic); acquisition_methods (22 adult / 36 pediatric acoustic tasks); compensation schedule
questions.quality_note: Full recruitment strategy, hardware, task inventory, collectors, and compensation documented

questions.name: Version History Documentation
questions.description: Presence of multiple version records and associated dates
questions.score_label: ≥2 versions with change summaries and release dates
questions.evidence: 'v1.0 January 17, 2025 (306 participants, 12,523 recordings); v1.1 January 17, 2025 (added MFCC features); v2.0.0 April 16, 2025; v2.0.1 August 18, 2025; v3.0.0 released 2025 (833 adults, ~61,937 recordings)' with version-specific DOIs
questions.quality_note: Five versions with dated release history, change summaries, and per-version DOIs

questions.name: Associated Publications
questions.description: Presence of formal citations or DOI-linked references
questions.score_label: Multiple references and dataset DOI cross-links
questions.evidence: citation: Bensoussan et al., Interspeech 2024, https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926; Zenodo archive https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13834653; dataset DOI 10.13026/37yb-1t42; NIH RePORTER project link
questions.quality_note: Multiple DOI-linked references plus cross-linked dataset and grant identifiers

questions.name: Human Subject Representation
questions.description: Inclusion of human subjects, demographic diversity, or subgroup details
questions.evidence: six subpopulations (Voice, Neurological aged 44-85, Mood/Psychiatric, Respiratory, Pediatric aged 2-18, Control) each with detailed clinical criteria and validation methods; why_not_representative enumerates selection biases; English-speaking adults 18-120
questions.quality_note: Rich subgroup demographics with diagnostic criteria, age ranges, and explicit representativeness caveats

questions.name: Findability (Persistent Links)
questions.description: Dataset includes persistent URLs for access and documentation
questions.evidence: page: https://docs.b2ai-voice.org; external_resources include https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/, https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep, https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/11376382 and 10+ more
questions.quality_note: Numerous persistent, resolvable URLs for access and documentation

questions.name: Accessibility (Access Mechanism)
questions.description: Describes how users can obtain the dataset
questions.score_label: Fully defined access path (platform, login, policy)
questions.evidence: PhysioNet registered access (sign Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access Agreement); raw audio via controlled access: 'email DACO@b2ai-voice.org and complete a Data Access Request Form (DARF), Data Use Agreement (DUA), and institutional Data Use and Transfer Agreement (DTUA)'
questions.quality_note: Fully defined multi-tier access path with platform, agreements, and contact points

questions.name: Reusability (License Clarity)
questions.description: License is clearly defined and permits identifiable reuse cases
questions.evidence: 'Commercial and non-commercial research use permitted for Authorized Researchers. No export controls apply'; prohibited_uses and discouraged_uses explicitly bound reuse (no re-identification, no sale, non-clinical discrimination prohibited)
questions.quality_note: License explicitly defines permitted reuse and clear prohibited/discouraged cases

questions.name: Data Integrity and Provenance
questions.description: Presence of change logs or provenance tracking
questions.evidence: version_access: 'All dataset versions available through PhysioNet... with version-specific DOIs'; updates block with dated release log; distribution_dates with per-version dates and counts; retention_limit policy
questions.quality_note: Structured version control with timestamped releases and persistent per-version DOIs

questions.name: Interlinking Across Platforms
questions.description: Metadata connects dataset records across multiple platforms
questions.evidence: Cross-links to PhysioNet, Health Data Nexus (https://healthdatanexus.ai/content/b2ai-voice/1.0/), GitHub (eipm/bridge2ai-docs, sensein/b2aiprep, sensein/senselab), Zenodo, NIH RePORTER, bridge2ai.org
questions.quality_note: Rich cross-platform interlinking across distribution, code, archive, and funder records

strengths: Complete structural metadata: all mandatory fields populated with rich, multi-paragraph narrative content
Exemplary ethical and privacy documentation including USF Single IRB approval, HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification, Certificate of Confidentiality, and a dedicated bioethics module
Comprehensive funding detail with agency, grant numbers (3OT2OD032720-01S3, R01EB030362), award amounts, and project dates
Strong technical transparency: preprocessing tools with repository URLs, licenses, and concrete parameters (16 kHz, 25ms window, 513xN spectrograms)
Excellent FAIR compliance with persistent version-specific DOIs, BIDS v1.9.0 conformance, tiered access mechanisms, and dense cross-platform interlinking
weaknesses: No explicit byte-level file sizes are given; dimensional and count metadata substitute for storage-size figures
Representativeness is well-caveated but the dataset remains English-only and geographically limited in current releases (a dataset property, not a documentation gap)
No quantitative re-identification risk analysis is reported ('No analysis of potential re-identification impact conducted')
recommendations: Add approximate on-disk file/dataset sizes (e.g., GB per release) alongside the existing dimensional metadata
Report results of a formal re-identification risk assessment once conducted, as flagged in participant_privacy
As Spanish-language and multimodal (imaging, genomics) releases ship, extend keywords and subpopulation documentation to reflect broadened coverage
